description: Test suite for OAuth store functionality in Mattermost, including CRUD operations for OAuth apps, access data, auth data, and related retrieval functions.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreSaveApp
methods.description: Tests saving OAuth applications, including validation for existing IDs, invalid apps, and successful save.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreGetApp
methods.description: Tests retrieving OAuth applications by ID, user, and listing all apps.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreUpdateApp
methods.description: Tests updating OAuth applications, including validation for missing name, non-existent app, and successful update.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreSaveAccessData
methods.description: Tests saving OAuth access data, including validation for incomplete data.

methods.name: testOAuthUpdateAccessData
methods.description: Tests updating OAuth access data, including validation for invalid tokens and successful update.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreGetAccessData
methods.description: Tests retrieving OAuth access data by token and refresh token, including error cases.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreRemoveAccessData
methods.description: Tests removal of OAuth access data by token.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreRemoveAllAccessData
methods.description: Tests removal of all OAuth access data.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreGetAuthData
methods.description: Tests retrieving OAuth auth data by code.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreRemoveAuthData
methods.description: Tests removal of OAuth auth data by code.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreRemoveAuthDataByUser
methods.description: Tests deleting OAuth auth data for a user.

methods.name: testOAuthGetAuthorizedApps
methods.description: Tests retrieving authorized OAuth applications for a user.

methods.name: testOAuthGetAccessDataByUserForApp
methods.description: Tests retrieving access data for a user and app.

methods.name: testOAuthStoreDeleteApp
methods.description: Tests deleting an OAuth app and ensuring related sessions and access data are also deleted.
